summary: Frontend-only testing of Shred Legend updates (song picker, bend-after-tap, master limiter, uploaded bass samples, vibrato) and Jam Session regression. All targeted behaviors verified. Pre-existing warnings (duplicate key, empty img src on free-play) ignored per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (ignored per request) duplicate React key warning still logged on Shred Legend playing scene; worth addressing for cleanliness.
Pre-existing (ignored per request) empty-string img src on free-play.
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage flag jma_player_name_skipped_v1=1 to bypass name modal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Automation setup confirmed: set localStorage 'jma_player_name_skipped_v1'='1', reload, then click [data-testid=audio-unlock-overlay] once. Intro song picker shows shred-song-0..4 + shred-start-btn (Surprise Me). Song-name HUD matches picked song. BEND button activates (yellow gradient + translate transform via inline style) on hold in Notes mode and is absent in Chords mode. Rapid note tapping during play produces no errors, timer keeps decrementing. No 4xx/5xx on any /assets/audio/bass/ or drum sample files. Jam Session (#/free-play) guitar renders and all tone/mode toggles work. Result card buttons shred-again-btn (Random) and shred-pick-btn (Pick Song) both verified end-to-end.

verified_scenarios.song_picker: All 5 song buttons present with labels (Garage Stomp 96bpm, Surf Riot 126bpm, Giant Stomp 82bpm, Kindie Riot 168bpm, Alley Cat Strut 104bpm). Clicking shred-song-3 => HUD '♪ Kindie Riot'. shred-start-btn randomizes.
verified_scenarios.result_card_flow: After 45s result card shown; shred-pick-btn returns to intro-card; shred-again-btn starts a random song (verified Garage Stomp -> Giant Stomp).
verified_scenarios.bend_after_tap: Tapped note-6 (mouse down/up ~80ms), then held BEND => bend button inline style switches to yellow linear-gradient (255,224,122 -> 255,204,0) with translateY pressed state; no console errors. Keyboard note+'b' combination raised no errors.
verified_scenarios.bend_absent_in_chords: Clicking guitar-mode-chords renders guitar-chord-grid and removes guitar-bend from DOM; switching back restores it.
verified_scenarios.no_clipping_errors: Rapid-fire 100 note presses across 5 pads during active song: timer continued (14s observed), no console errors.
verified_scenarios.sustain_vibrato: Holding note-6 for 2s produced no console errors or UI glitches.
verified_scenarios.audio_assets: Zero 4xx/5xx responses for /assets/audio/bass/*.mp3 or drum files (Bass drum - kick.mp3, Snare.mp3, Hi Hat closed.mp3, Crash cymbal.mp3). All 8 bass files (A2,B2,C3,D3,E3,F3,G3,A3) present on disk.
verified_scenarios.regression_shred: intro -> ready-count -> playing with 7-character crowd, meter-fill, tier-label, timeleft all rendered. No layout breakage.
verified_scenarios.regression_free_play: guitar-instrument renders, note pads play, BEND present in Notes mode, CHORDS/NOTES/CLEAN/CRUNCH toggles all functional, no new console errors.
